sources.title: IsmatS/mbert-az-ner · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of mBERT (Multilingual BERT) for Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the Azerbaijani language. It recognizes several entity types commonly used in Azerbaijani text, providing solid performance on tasks requiring entity extraction, such as personal names, locations, organizations, and dates.
